description: Are these two specific archive records connected -- and if so, exactly why? Traces the real path between them through Colour Memory's stored relationship graph (e.g. two Wada colours that share membership in the same published combination) and returns the actual path, not just a yes/no. States plainly when two records are NOT connected, and always states what a shared connection does not prove -- e.g. that two colours sharing a Wada combination were independently asserted as a pair, not just co-published in the same numbered plate. Get record_id values from archive_search or colour_card.
name: why_connected
title: Why Connected
